name: com.commencis.appconnect.sdk.extensions.mobileservices.google.AppConnectFCMListenerService
description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers an AppConnect push, this Dataroid extension processes the message and keeps the Firebase push token current for AppConnect.
disableEffect: The app remains usable, but AppConnect push messages will no longer be handled and refreshed Firebase push tokens will not reach AppConnect.
